name: Autumn Music Festival
description: A vibrant two-day festival featuring local and international artists.
teaser: Get ready for the ultimate autumn vibes!

name: Tech Conference 2025
description: Annual tech conference with talks, workshops, and networking opportunities.
teaser: Innovate, connect, and learn from the best.

name: Vienna Rooftop Sessions
description: An open-air evening of electronic music, live visuals, and panoramic city views.
teaser: Sunset beats above the rooftops of Vienna.

name: Danube Street Food Market
description: Two days of international street food, local drinks, cooking demonstrations, and live music.
teaser: Taste your way around the world beside the Danube.

name: Alpine Trail Challenge
description: A supported mountain running event with beginner, intermediate, and expert routes through the Tyrolean Alps.
teaser: Climb higher, run farther, and conquer the Alps.

name: Indie Game Expo Graz
description: Meet independent developers, play upcoming games, attend design talks, and compete in community tournaments.
teaser: Discover the next generation of independent games.

name: Linz Future Mobility Forum
description: Experts and startups present new ideas for cycling, public transport, electric vehicles, and connected cities.
teaser: Explore how tomorrow's cities will move.

name: Salzburg Jazz Nights
description: Three intimate nights of contemporary jazz performed across historic venues in Salzburg's old town.
teaser: World-class jazz in the heart of Salzburg.

name: Creative Makers Weekend
description: Hands-on workshops in printmaking, ceramics, product design, photography, and sustainable crafts.
teaser: Make something original with Vienna's creative community.

name: European AI Summit
description: Researchers, founders, and policy leaders discuss practical AI, responsible deployment, and emerging technology.
teaser: Three days shaping the practical future of AI.

name: Winter Lights Festival
description: Immersive light installations, winter food, acoustic performances, and family activities beside the lake.
teaser: See the lakeside transformed by light.

name: New Year's Masquerade
description: A formal New Year's celebration with orchestral music, DJs, midnight performances, and elegant dining.
teaser: Welcome the new year behind the mask.

name: Coffee & Code Weekend
description: A relaxed community hackathon for web developers, designers, students, and open-source contributors.
teaser: Build useful things, meet developers, drink excellent coffee.

name: Sustainable Living Fair
description: Products, workshops, and talks focused on renewable energy, low-waste living, ethical fashion, and green homes.
teaser: Practical ideas for a more sustainable everyday life.

name: Prague Digital Arts Week
description: Interactive installations, generative art, audiovisual performances, and creative technology workshops.
teaser: Art, sound, and code meet in Prague.
